name: DrawEduMath
summary: 2,030 images of students' handwritten answers to 188 math problems, each described by a teacher, with teacher-written and synthetic questions and answers about the images.

license.note: The dataset card says CC BY-NC 4.0 for all of it; ASSISTments' responsible use guidelines put the students' images under CC BY-NC 4.0 and the descriptions and questions under CC BY 4.0, and the problems keep their curricula's licenses. The code is Apache-2.0.

access_note: The images load by address from ASSISTments' servers.
cite: Baral, S., Lucy, L., Knight, R., Ng, A., Soldaini, L., Heffernan, N. T., & Lo, K. (2025). DrawEduMath: Evaluating Vision Language Models with Expert-Annotated Students' Hand-Drawn Math Images. NAACL 2025. https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2025.naacl-long.352

fits.how: No slot yet: it could test whether a model reads a picture of a learner's work correctly, in agent tests that start with pictures, for non-commercial use.

connect.note: Comes down as its CSV of questions about pictures of students' work. Agent tests can start with pictures, but a model reading one isn't what they rate yet, so nothing is made from it. Non-commercial: asks you to accept its license first.
